title: Fe-substituted Na3.5V1.5Mn0.5(PO4)3 NaSICON cathode with multi-electron reactions and improved energy output
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,21465-21477
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA00418K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Loubna Chayal, Soraia El Moutchou, Noha Sabi, Hicham Ben Youcef, Hasna Aziam, Mohamed Saadi, Mohammed Hadouchi
An Fe-substituted Na3.5V1.5Mn0.25Fe0.25(PO4)3 NaSICON cathode was designed via a Pechini method. The electrochemical evaluation in Na cell showed multi-electron activity and enhanced Na kinetics enabling high energy density.
